pattern.short_summary: The interaction is organized as a tree or open graph in which alternatives coexist, rather than as a single ordered track the user advances along.
pattern.definition: The interaction is organized as a tree or open graph in which alternatives coexist, rather than as a single ordered track the user advances along. The user can fork off a side path, pick a different branch, or take steps in an order of their choosing, and the alternatives remain live rather than being replaced. The branching structure is often itself the interface object.
pattern.structural_signature: State is held as multiple simultaneously extant paths from a shared origin; a control exists for creating a new path and for switching which path is active; paths are displayed together (as a tree, a canvas of branches, or parallel panels) so their coexistence is visible. Advancing along one path does not destroy the others.

dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.
